tasks.goal: Add Get-CollabStatus.ps1 script for quick collaboration system status (Hard Gate task)
acceptance_criteria: Script exists at exact path agent_collab/scripts/Get-CollabStatus.ps1
Script is executable: pwsh -NoProfile -File agent_collab/scripts/Get-CollabStatus.ps1 succeeds with exit 0
Output includes at minimum: Mode, Lock status+age, Wave/Queue summary, Recent handoffs count, Inbox raw counts (per runtime), Last 5 decisions, Current git branch + collab branches, Worktree count
Script is read-only (no mutations) and handles missing files/empty state gracefully
Script uses Assert-EditScope style discipline in comments (even though read-only)
Critic (integration verification) approves after reviewing the script and running it

summary: Single-task wave. Narrow scope: one new read-heavy script under scripts/. Low risk. No docs impact. File ownership prediction is accurate and minimal. Should run serially in one Coder worktree.
risk_notes: Very low risk — only touches new file in allowed scripts/ directory.
Main value is exercising the full Coder + Critic + promotion + restart flow for the Hard Gate.
Acceptance criteria are executable (script must actually run and produce expected sections).
